newsitem.title: LATVIA: VIP TIES IN CHARITY AUCTION FOR HOSPITAL.
newsitem.headline: VIP TIES IN CHARITY AUCTION FOR HOSPITAL.

text.p: Ties of Latvia's politicians and cultural stars will be sold at a charity auction on May 30 with the proceeds to go to the Children's Cardiological centre at the Gailezers hiospital, Junior Chamber International said on Wednesday.
"The Tired Ties" is the name of the charity action in which used ties of Latvia's president, prime minister, president of the biggest commercial bank Parekss and others will be sold.
The centre is currently gathering funds for a $182,000 ultrasonograph.
